author: Kat Pettibone
title: Timothee Chalamet and Kylie Jenner Enjoy Casual Date Night at Yankees Game in New York City - NewsBreak
text:
By Kat Pettibone ,
1 hours ago Timothée Chalamet took girlfriend Kylie Jenner out to the ballgame.
Chalamet, 29, and Jenner, 28, were spotted in the stands for game four of the American League Division Series game between the Yankees and the Toronto Blue Jays at Yankee Stadium in New York City on Wednesday, October 8.
The pair, who sat behind home plate in the front row, kept it casual for their sporty date night. Chalamet supported his home team in a leather Yankees jacket and baseball cap that hid his newly shaved head , while Jenner stayed warm in a blue coat. She opted to keep her hood up, shielding her from the rain.
Throughout the game, Chalamet — a NYC native — could be seen cheering and clapping loudly for his team. He even appeared briefly on the video board, yelling “Yanks in 5! Let’s go!” and holding up five fingers for the camera.
Kylie Jenner Joins Timothee Chalamet at ‘Marty Supreme’ Premiere in New York City
Wednesday’s game marks the second time Chalamet and Jenner have been spotted in the Big Apple recently. Earlier this week, the actor brought his girlfriend to the New York Film Festival premiere of his upcoming movie Marty Supreme . In a video shared by Variety , the couple could be seen laughing and smiling inside a restaurant after the event, where they “sat in a corner booth cuddling as party goers congratulated Chalamet on his performance.”
A separate video posted by NYFF’s official X account on Monday, October 6, showed Jenner backstage at the festival as director Josh Safdie walked out to speak with the audience about the sports comedy, which follows Chalamet’s Marty Mauser, a man training to become a ping-pong player. The film is loosely based on the professional table tennis player Marty Reisman and also stars Gwyneth Paltrow and Fran Drescher .
NEW YORK, NEW YORK - OCTOBER 08: Timothée Chalamet cheers alongside Kylie Jenner during the fourth inning of game four of the American League Division Series between the New York Yankees and the Toronto Blue Jays at Yankee Stadium on October 08, 2025 in New York City. (Photo by Ishika Samant/Getty Images) Ishika Samant/Getty Images Chalamet and Jenner were first linked in 2023 , shortly after Jenner split from Travis Scott . (The exes share daughter Stormi, 7, and son Aire, 3.) Us Weekly confirmed their romance in April, with a source sharing that Chalamet is unlike “any of the other guys” Jenner previously dated and “although he may not seem like her type, they have really good chemistry.”
They have since attended multiple public outings together. Although he walked the red carpet solo, Jenner was by Chalamet’s side at the 2024 Golden Globes and Academy Awards, where he earned nominations for his portrayal of Bob Dylan in the biopic A Complete Unknown. The twosome made their official red carpet debut at the 70th David Di Donatello at Cinecitta Studios in Rome earlier this year.
“Kylie’s really happy and relieved they finally made their debut. It was time, and she wanted to publicly support him and show how proud of him she is,” a source exclusively told Us at the time. “She and Timothée have gotten really serious, and this was a big step.”
Timothee Chalamet and Kylie Jenner Cheer on New York Knicks at Playoff Game
Although rumors swirled that they had called it quits in August after Chalamet was missing from Jenner’s 28th birthday celebration, an insider confirmed to Us at the time that the pair are “still together” and going strong. They aren’t, however, in a rush to take their relationship to the next level.
This is a very different relationship dynamic than what Kylie is used to,” a separate source explained. “[It’s] opened her eyes to the more artistic side of the industry.”
